import json, os, time
from pathlib import Path
expected = ['/home/yhwang/fyp/xvla_native/venv/bin/python', '-u', '-m', 'deploy', '--model_path', '/home/yhwang/fyp/xvla_native/model', '--port', '8794', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--disable_slurm', '--output_dir', '/mnt/d/FYP/First_Phase/scene_demo/results/2026-10-12-xvla-native-benchmark/server_runtime']
found = []
deadline = time.monotonic() + 4
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    found = []
    for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
        try:
            argv = p.joinpath('cmdline').read_bytes().decode().rstrip('\0').split('\0')
            if argv == expected:
                found.append({'pid': int(p.name), 'argv': argv, 'cwd': os.readlink(p/'cwd'), 'stat': (p/'stat').read_text()})
        except (OSError, UnicodeError): pass
    if found: break
    time.sleep(0.1)
print(json.dumps(found))
